question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the milestones of Nemtsov's physics education (starting the studies, completing the degree, defending the doctoral dissertation), in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Đây là ba mốc của cùng một lộ trình học vấn, cần đủ cả ba để trả lời đúng thứ tự.
criterion: Milestones of his physics education: starting studies, completing the degree, defending the PhD dissertation.

gold_events.text: Began physics studies at Gorky State University.
Completed physics degree at Gorky State University.
Defended PhD dissertation in physics and mathematics.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, summarize the popular elections held during the 1990s in which Nemtsov stood as a candidate, won or lost, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Tóm tắt cần đủ mọi cuộc bầu cử trong giai đoạn 1990 đến 1999, mỗi cuộc là một mốc độc lập.
criterion: Popular elections actually held in which Nemtsov stood as a candidate (won or lost), excluding candidacies withdrawn before the vote.

gold_events.text: Elected to Supreme Soviet of the Russian Republic.
Re-elected Governor of Nizhny Novgorod region by popular vote.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the times Nemtsov took up a post in the Russian federal government (appointment or reappointment as Deputy Prime Minister or minister), in chronological order (the two posts taken up in the same year in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Câu cần đủ ba lần nhận chức trong chính phủ liên bang trong cùng một giai đoạn ngắn.
criterion: Taking up a post in the Russian federal government (appointment or reappointment as Deputy Prime Minister or minister).

gold_events.text: Appointed First Deputy Prime Minister of Russia, responsible for energy reform.
Served as Minister of Fuel and Energy.
Reappointed Deputy Prime Minister; resigned shortly afterwards.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list Nemtsov's leadership events in the Union of Right Forces party (elected leader, confirmed as leader by the party congress, or resigned from the leadership), in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Câu cần ba bước trong cùng một chuỗi lãnh đạo đảng, không thể trả lời bằng một mốc.
criterion: Leadership events in the Union of Right Forces party: elected leader, confirmation by congress, resignation from leadership.

gold_events.text: Elected leader of the Union of Right Forces party and its parliamentary group.
Party congress confirmed him as Union of Right Forces leader.
Resigned from the Union of Right Forces party leadership.
